svg.text: Read left to right. Screen IDs match the six wireframe sheets. Rectangles = screens/actions; diamonds = decisions.
No → access denied + retry A01. Project can also capture root tasks directly. Prefix becomes immutable.
Nested sections: maximum 3 levels. Ready to work excludes manual/dependency blockers; ordinary views keep blocked work visible.
No unfinished subtasks → owner marks Done. Complete all → remaining nonterminal subtasks Done; Canceled stays Canceled. PR merged never implies Done.
Duplicate → open existing or restore archived task. New issue → copy title/body once. Fresh qualifying PR events may move Ready → In progress → In review; never Done.
Agent uses project grants and idempotency keys. Stale write → decision_required / deliberate retry. Owner can revoke key. Agent cannot restore note history.
Failed transfer → retry / remove C05. Note autosave: C06 → Saved; failure preserves draft; conflict → R06 compare latest and retry. History restore C04 creates a new revision.

Reopen rejected → no partial change. Archive preserves status/dependencies. Restore only clears selected marker. Delete requires archived target, owner, no external dependents, subtree/file confirmation;
Found → open result directly (skip C03). Filters use AND across groups / OR within a group. Mobile M01–M06 supports the same core actions; task detail is full-screen.
